description: Second bounded adaptive sampled-path-gap atlas. It reuses integrity-checked M20 observations from the completed v1 atlas, adds target-contour samples, and constrains visible surrogate overshoot. The processed COMSOL data remains a reference-only layer.
scope: Exploratory M20 sampled-path-gap mapping. Every third new point is selected to constrain values that leave the observed PWE range; the remaining points refine prescribed target contours. This contour map is neither an M25 validation nor a full-Brillouin-zone or continuum certificate.
